title: Marmite-Glazed Chicken with Crispy Chickpeas
tagline: Love it, hate it, then eat the lot. One tray, no drama.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Pat the drained chickpeas very dry with a clean tea towel. Dry chickpeas crisp. Wet ones sulk.
Toss chickpeas and onion wedges with the paprika and 1 tbsp oil on a large tray. Rub the chicken with the remaining oil and nestle it on top, skin up.
Roast for 25 minutes. Meanwhile, stir the Marmite, honey, the juice of half the lemon and 1 tbsp hot water into a loose glaze.
Brush the glaze over the chicken skin. Roast 15–20 minutes more, until lacquered and the juices run clear, with no pink near the bone.
Stir the zest of the lemon and a squeeze of its juice into the yoghurt. Rest the chicken for 5 minutes.
Spoon the lemon yoghurt onto plates, pile on the chickpeas, onions and chicken, then scatter with parsley. Spoon over any tray juices.
image_prompt: Roasted bone-in chicken thighs with deep mahogany sticky glazed skin, resting on crisp golden chickpeas and soft red onion wedges, a swirl of lemony white yoghurt beside them, scattered with chopped parsley, served on a wide white ceramic plate with a lemon wedge.
alt_text: Glossy glazed chicken thighs on crisp chickpeas and red onion, with lemon yoghurt and parsley on a white plate.
caption_hook:
Marmite on chicken. Stay with us.
It turns sticky, savoury and faintly sweet, like a very good gravy that learned to crisp.
Are you a lover or a hater?
